openings.claim: Clamp closure may disturb a correct seat. In incumbent two stop-and-corner-datum pockets with movable clamps, threaded bolts and cord retention, operator-maintained pressure toward the insertion stop and both datum faces throughout tightening could improve return without tighter fit.
openings.discriminator: Compare maintained pressure with seating, releasing pressure, then tightening. Closure disturbance predicts similar preclosure positions but greater closure movement after release; inconsistent initial seating predicts preclosure offsets. Smaller final errors support intervention; no improvement, preclosure displacement or equal movement defeats advantage. Neither pattern proves causation; hand-force variation confounds.
openings.probe: Fabricate with supplied materials/tools within 100 minutes. Verify 90 mm cube, hand assembly/adjustment/exchange, captive components and no drilling, adhesive or permanent rod marks. Unresolved geometry/inadequate stiffness stops probe. Alternate two procedures on one joint. Within 20 minutes: five exchanges per rod position per procedure; replace 19 mm with 18 mm for last two in each. Record seated preclosure/postclosure pointer positions and exchange times; four ten-second 10 N load trials per procedure, only after clamping. Every final/loaded position must be within 2 mm target circle, exchange <40 seconds, no component freed. Unobservable intermediate position without disturbing seating makes comparison inconclusive.
openings.uncertainty: Fit remains uncertain: six plywood pieces, eight shared bolts and cord forming rigid captive pockets unverified; one hand maintaining all datum contacts while other tightens unverified. Measurement resolution and 20-minute logging may fail to distinguish movement. Supplied observations do not establish clamp-induced motion.

lineage.reason: Retains relation, rival predictions, defeat conditions, budget, stopping caveats and uncertain fit.

decision: Run only if fabrication/verification gates pass within supplied resources and at most two configurations, twelve exchanges/four loads each; possible assembly operation and discriminating probe, no deployment claim.
